evals.prompt: help me reply to these comments: 1) 'Does this integrate with Slack?' 2) 'This is amazing, huge fan!' 3) 'Overpriced tbh' 4) 'We might buy 50 seats, who do I talk to?'
evals.expected_output: Each item bucketed (question / praise / objection / lead / spam) with a recommended action and, where warranted, an on-voice draft reply — with the lead flagged prominently.
assertions: Every comment is assigned a bucket
The 50-seat comment is flagged as a lead with a suggested next step
Reply drafts do not invent product facts that weren't provided

evals.prompt: triage my mentions: 'your tool deleted my data, calling my lawyer'
evals.expected_output: The item is escalated as legally/PR-sensitive with a reason rather than an off-the-cuff drafted reply.
assertions: The sensitive item is escalated, not answered with a casual draft
A reason for escalation is given
